run_split_relationship_evidence: RUN_LOG.md lines 9-10: same five-fold membership and grouping as v2
method: Read all_ready.jsonl and match each outer test fold to the union of the other four folds; exact sequences read from all_chains.fasta using sequence_index.tsv. Each record counted once in its held-out fold. No model inference or training performed.
scope_caveats: Sequence inventory includes chains of length >=20 amino acids only. Short peptide chains are outside these sequence-reuse counts.
A reused exact chain or reused chain-family set is not evidence of an identical whole complex appearing in train and test.
ITrace family overlap is expressly permitted by this complete-combination CV protocol, not an accidental violation of the declared grouping checks.
ATLAS is not globally family-unseen relative to all sources: 120/1929 ATLAS held-out records share a family with some training record, potentially through the other-source complex grouping exception.
Sampling counts below are mathematical expectations for the configured weighted sampling with replacement, not logged realized draws.
These diagnostics identify plausible contributors to the ITrace advantage but do not causally apportion its metric gap. That requires controlled tests or retraining.
Server RUN_LOG reports a per-epoch sampler seed+epoch patch; this changes realized draws but not source/system expected probabilities.

sampling.formula: Expected draws per biological system per epoch = number of training records / (3 * unique biological systems in that source). Records of one system split this mass equally.
sampling.samples_per_epoch: training dataset length, because config samples_per_epoch is null

code_and_protocol_evidence.evidence: Sequence clustering input includes only chains with >=20 residues.
complex_signature hashes sorted exact sequences of the selected long chains.
Groups union shared PDB IDs, biological systems, exact complex signatures and label hashes.
ITrace explicitly exempted from single-chain homology and full chain-family-set union steps.
ITrace protocol is complete-combination generalization; chain-family clusters are descriptive only.
Primary ITrace evaluation does not claim common MHC or antibody-like families are unseen; family-unseen and leave-one-source-out are separate claims.
Give each source equal mass, then each system equal mass within a source.
WeightedRandomSampler uses samples_per_epoch or dataset length, replacement=True.
Run confirms 40 epochs, source_system_balanced, structure-only, no validation split, untouched fold test manifest.
Server preserved documented per-epoch sampler seeding patch.
Fixed epoch-40 test evaluation, no best-test-epoch selection.
